title: Chapter 338 Your Hometown
content:
Chapter 338 Your Hometown

After a long time, Venerable Yuan sighed deeply.

The entire Yuanji Temple was suddenly filled with sadness.

He looks bright and beautiful, and is admired by countless people, but in fact he is tortured day and night.

The torture that never sees the future.

“It would be great if I could find that point that broke the loop.”

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng seemed to be thinking.

Unexpectedly, this old guy's situation was almost the same as that of him.

But I am obviously much better than him, so why is this happening?

Could it be that there is really only this world, there is no higher world?

No, it is impossible, absolutely impossible.

This shouldn't be the case in the world.

Lu Daosheng became more and more impatient.

At this time, the Yuanji Venerable in the distance also noticed Lu Daosheng's changes.

He was stunned for a moment, as if he realized something, and his face suddenly turned gleeful.

"You are the same as me, too?!"

There was surprise in his eyes and he stared at Lu Daosheng in the distance.

After he asked this, Lu Daosheng's impatient mood suddenly became a little angry.

Bang!

As Lu Daosheng slapped him out, Venerable Yuan suddenly flew backwards.

"Cough, ache, hahahaha."

At this moment, although Venerable Yuanji was lying on the ground, in a mess, his face was filled with a smile.

That crazy smile.

He is not lonely.

Moreover, Lu Daosheng was so much better than him, but the other party was still the same as him. Compared with this, he suddenly became less sad.

In the distance, Lu Daosheng ignored the Master Yuanji and left the Yuanji Temple directly.

He had no questions asked this guy.

Walking in the endless sea of stars, Lu Daosheng walked aimlessly.

He was thinking while walking.

The point that breaks the loop?

This probably requires strength.

Maybe it's just that he is not strong enough now.

"System, upgrade."

Buzz —

Lu Daosheng's aura suddenly began to rise.

But Lu Daosheng still didn't feel anything special, but his strength became stronger.

"Rise again."

Buzz —

The breath rose again.

......

In this way, Lu Daosheng has risen many times, and the surrounding space has gone from destruction to rebirth, and he has reincarnated many times.

Feeling everything around him, Lu Daosheng's face still had no improvement.

Looking up and looking into the distance.

The endless starry sky is beautiful, with many worlds and creatures there.

But that wasn't what he wanted.

At this moment, he felt a little helpless for the first time.

Even if you have a system, it seems that it is not omnipotent.

And from when, the system suddenly became very silent, as if hiding something.

"System, don't you want me to find a new world?"

Lu Daosheng asked suddenly.

【no】

The system's answer surprised Lu Daosheng. He hadn't heard the system's answer for a long time.

"Then do you know where the new world is?"

However, the system was silent again.

I don't know how long it took.

The system sounded again.

[Host big, new world, you have to find it yourself]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's expression was a little dim.

"But I'm a little confused."

[Everyone has times of confusion, but when you break the status quo, you will usher in a new life]

[Host, there is a place I can send you, and there may be some inspiration there]

"where?"

Lu Daosheng said curiously.

【Your hometown】

home?

Lu Daosheng frowned slightly, but suddenly, he realized something and his breathing suddenly became rapid.

"System, you take it seriously?"

"Can I really go back?"

【Yes, but the energy consumed will be huge】

After all, it was the system that brought Lu Daosheng to this world back then.

After bringing Lu Daosheng, the system fell into a deep sleep because of its huge energy consumption.

This is also the reason why Lu Daosheng's system was activated so slowly back then.

At this time, Lu Daosheng was excited.

That was the excitement coming from the bottom of my bones.

I can go home even if I do.

That, the real home.

Even though he has already started a family and a career here, the concepts of the two are different.

"System, we'll set off when I prepare."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng quickly broke through the space and rushed towards the other side of the starry sky.

.........

On the other side of the starry sky.

Now, the deserted city has completely become the absolute overlord on the other side of the starry sky.

Any force that exists on the other side of the starry sky will be unconditionally followed by the decisions of the deserted city.

On the other side of the starry sky, the deserted city is absolutely supreme.

In the deserted city.

A half-white man sat leisurely in a teahouse, enjoying the fragrant tea in his cup, and from time to time he looked at the pedestrians outside through the window.

"How wonderful, how wonderful."

At this time, a man in green slowly walked into the teahouse and walked straight towards the man.

"The Lord of the Palace, my subordinates have investigated it clearly. In the inner city of the deserted city, the towering tree is really a tree of immortality."

Hearing this, Shi Space Ying's expression suddenly lit up.

"Sure enough, just sitting here, I have already felt the aura emitted by the tree of immortality."

"I'm afraid that just living in this city can also achieve the effect of prolonging life."

Time and space win with emotion in their eyes.

He found this giant city incredible.

It brings together countless legendary treasures in the world, many of which he has never heard of.

But when he thought of the adult's strength, he understood it.

The most urgent task now is to restore his lost life as soon as possible.

"Can the price of the immortal fruit be found out clearly?"

Time and space won back to their senses and continued to ask.

Hearing this, the man in green shook his head slightly.

"The Lord of the Palace, they don't sell the Fruit, so there is no price,"

Speaking of this, he paused and looked a little hesitant.

Hearing that the fruit of immortality was not sold, Shijiying was a little unhappy. When he saw that the man in green didn't even talk about playing, he became even more angry.

"When did you become such a mother-in-law?"

Seeing that the owner of his palace was already a little angry, the man in green hurriedly knelt on the ground, which surprised the rest of the teahouse.

Many of the double-watching eyes suddenly looked over.

"District Master, calm down."

Time and Space Win's face was slightly dark, "Get up first."

"Yes, the Lord of the Palace."

After getting up, the man in green dared not hide it and continued to talk.

"The Lord of the Palace, the immortal tree grows in the inner city. The immortal fruits are not sold. The residents there seem to be eating them as snacks, so they can take them if they want to eat them."

Hearing this, Shikongying suddenly vomited out a sip of tea that had just been drunk into his mouth.

Puff ~

Can I eat the fruit of immortality as snacks? !

To waste natural resources, to waste natural resources!

Even the lord of the time and space hall could not eat it, but it was just snacks from others.

Just when Kong Ying felt very uncomfortable about this, a figure suddenly rang beside him.

"Your Excellency wants the fruit of immortality?"
